response.sql: WITH matched_income AS (SELECT ma.college, i.amount FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id WHERE ma.college IS NOT NULL) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, 1.0 * SUM(amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM matched_income) AS income_fraction FROM matched_income GROUP BY college
